'''Thom Tran'asi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and ran the vehicle lot [[Thom's Trusty Transport]]. He was injured during riots that occurred in the city of [[Gadrin]], following the execution of [[Borus Ferthyn]] by the [[Thaereian military]].<ref name="Night's Promise">{{LivingForce|Night Eyes: Night's Promise}}</ref>
